item.title: ‘Power’ Creator Courtney Kemp Tells 50 Cent To “Move On” After He Takes Shots At Her
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: 50 Cent publicly criticized Power creator Courtney Kemp over budget issues and her role, then attacked her character when she clapped back, sparking social media debate.
item.content:encoded:
50 Cent continues to prove he will turn on you on a dime if you do or say something he doesn’t like.

In a new interview with Variety, the Street Fighter star took off his boxing gloves and said nothing nice about Courtney Kemp, creator of the Starz hit drama Power, blaming her for budget issues, downplaying his role in the rise of the Power Universe, and claiming she slept with cast and crew members.

If you ask social media, Power is basically the brainchild of the Queen’s hip-hop star, but that is far from the truth: Kemp wrote and developed the concept as the showrunner. At the same time, 50 Cent served as an executive producer and eventually joined the cast.

Regardless, 50 Cent told Variety that Kemp downplayed his contributions to the series. When asked if there was someone he never wanted to collaborate with ever again, he immediately mentioned Kemp.

“I don’t think that she’s wholeheartedly a bad person, I just think that it got out of control for her,” 50 Cent said. “After the success of Power, she would go, ‘I wrote it.’ Well, you did write it, but I uploaded everything that you wrote, and we got a ‘no’ from everybody before we got a ‘yes,’ and I wrote songs that captured, at its nucleus, each one of the leads that we had and that emotionally captured energy for scenes.”

He went on to claim his songs were instrumental in pitching to Starz’s then-CEO Chris Albrecht, saying Kemp “forgot” about his contributions.

50 Cent Believes He Was Instrumental In Pushing The Show & Its Success

The G-Unit general said he had a lot of power pushing the show, leading to the cable network keeping the show, drawing eyes on the show, and making it the powerhouse it has become, going on to spawn several spinoff series, one of them being Raising Kanan, which 50 Cent claimed Kemp didn’t want to happen.

“Half the s**t she was saying just didn’t make sense,” he added.

Well, Kemp had time for Curtis Jackson and, in a statement to Variety, said he was rarely at budget meetings but wished him well, gave him credit for helping make the show be a success, and basically wants him to keep her name out of his mouth.

“While 50’s recollection of budgets and production requirements is uninformed, as he was rarely in a budget meeting, I have never once understated his importance in the genesis of Power. While he did not write nor create the series, he was a large part of its birth. That said, I am completely bewildered by his need to mention me in interviews or podcasts. I have completely moved on in my career, and I hope that the imminent success of Street Fighter allows him to do the same.”

Well damn.

In response to Kemp’s statement, 50 Cent hopped on social media and basically slut shaming her, accusing her of sleeping with cast and crew members in a post that has since been deleted.

This isn’t the first time 50 Cent has taken a swipe at Kemp, but she usually dismisses it as playful banter; this is the first time she’s clapped back at the rapper/mogul.

See what social media had to say below.

item.content:encoded:
Cardi B did her big one stepping into the Tiny Desk office and putting on a show.

Taking her talents to Washington, D.C., Bardi did NOT come to play. The Bronx MC performed some of her biggest hits, including “ErrTime,” “Up,” and her classic breakout record, “Bodak Yellow.”

The New York MC has been on a generational run and shows no signs of slowing down. After ending her seven-year album drought, Cardi released her sophmore album, AM I THE DRAMA?, last year.

The project marked her first full-length album since her Grammy-winning debut, Invasion of Privacy, dropped in 2018. Since then, Cardi has continued to make major moves, keeping her name in the conversation while delivering the energy fans have come to expect.

Following the album’s release in September, she also joined Bad Bunny during his Super Bowl halftime show, adding another major moment to her growing list of career highlights. Now, she’s bringing the same star power to NPR’s Tiny Desk series, giving fans a chance to hear some of her biggest records in a different setting.

item.title: Cardi B Took Over Tiny Desk, And The Internet Is Here For It
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: There are only a few times where it seems like the world still loves all of us. Like when there is that one time around the end of October when the NFL, NBA, college basketball, and the MLB playoffs are all on television at the same time. Or when Drake saved Top Boy to give […]
item.content:encoded:
There are only a few times where it seems like the world still loves all of us. Like when there is that one time around the end of October when the NFL, NBA, college basketball, and the MLB playoffs are all on television at the same time. Or when Drake saved Top Boy to give the show the proper ending it deserved. And you learn on a random Monday that Tiny Desk is Bardigang and got Belcalis Marlenis Almánzar to grace the office and set the desk ablaze.

Cardi B’s performance dropped and the internet clocked in like it was a Bronx block party. And for those that think Cardi’s performances are all flash and fancy outfits will be shocked to see the stripped down live performance and her larger-than-life personality into a space where there are no arena-sized screens, pyrotechnics or elaborate stage productions to hide behind. Just Cardi, a live band, a whole lot of hits and that unmistakable Cardi B energy.

The performance, which included “Hello,” “ErrTime,” “Man of Your Word,” “Be Careful,” “Up,” “AH HA,” “Bodak Yellow” and “I Like It,” gave fans a little bit of everything: the brash confidence, the vulnerability, the jokes and the party-starting records that helped make her a superstar. NPR even reported that the crowd was so large that some people had to be turned away. Being that NPR is in Washington, D.C., Cardi even dropped a small shout out to UCB’s “Sexy Lady” at the end of her set. 

Tiny Desk has become one of those rare corners of the internet where artists can remind people why they fell in love with them in the first place. Here is a look at the party thrown on X in honor of Cardi B’s performance.

item.title: OTF Jam Continues To Take Shots At Lil Durk From Behind Bars
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: With both OTF Jam and Lil Durk remain behind bars, Jam appears to be sneak dissing the Chicago rapper. Jam made headlines after serving as a key witness in Durk’s federal murder-for-hire case. He famously became the first OTF member to take the stand against Durk, accusing the rapper of allegedly orchestrated crimes. One of […]
item.content:encoded:
With both OTF Jam and Lil Durk remain behind bars, Jam appears to be sneak dissing the Chicago rapper.

Jam made headlines after serving as a key witness in Durk’s federal murder-for-hire case. He famously became the first OTF member to take the stand against Durk, accusing the rapper of allegedly orchestrated crimes.

One of the cases centered on the 2022 killing of Quando Rondo’s cousin, Lul Pab, in Los Angeles. However, Durk was acquitted of the charges in that case after the court found the prosecution has not met its burden of proof.

While awaiting further sentencing related to his own involvement in the case, Jam remains behind bars. Despite his incarceration, the former OTF member appears to still have access to his Instagram account, where a new post sparked more conversation about his ongoing tension with Durk.

The post featured a clip from the classic movie Don’t Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood. Jam captioned the clip, “The Nation of Lil Durk’s,” seemingly taking another jab at the rapper.

Meanwhile, Durk has yet to respond to Jam’s latest apparent shots as he awaits his next court proceedings. His separate VICAR case, which was originally scheduled to begin in October, has been pushed back to August 2027.

item.title: Tesla Stans Are Big Mad At Marques Brownlee aka MKBHD For Calling CAP on Elon’s Flying Car
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Tech reviewer Marques Brownlee questioned whether Elon Musk's flying Tesla Roadster is real, sparking backlash from Musk supporters who accused him of bias.
item.content:encoded:
Elon Musk, aka Bootleg Tony Stark, had the internet (mainly Tesla stans) salivating when he unveiled his “flying” Tesla Roadster, but one person, Marques Brownlee aka MKBHD, wasn’t so quick to give Musk all the praise, and people are BIG MAD about it.

Brownlee is one of the most popular tech reviewers in the world, so when he says he’s not feeling something, his words carry a lot of weight.

Everyone was blown away by Musk’s presentation for his long-awaited Tesla Roadster EV, which showed the vehicle making its way up a curved ramp, glued to it via a vacuum fan system, before launching off the ramp upside down, performing flips in the air, and using thrusters to right itself and land on the tarmac.

In another stunt, the Roadster took a page out of Knight Rider’s book by jumping over several Tesla vehicles, including a semi-truck, flipping upside down, then using its thrusters to land.

Musk also boasted that the vehicle could reach 230 mph and that the production Roadster could target half the speed of sound, or Mach 0.5 (383 mph). During the presentation, the Roadster did 0-60 mph in less than 1 second (0.81 seconds) in a test.

While Tesla stans and MAGA faithful are excited about Musk’s new EV, Brownlee wasn’t immediately sold.

On X (formerly Twitter), he wrote, “They really just got on stage and said this newly designed 4000+ pound car can do flips and go half the speed of sound (380+mph) and will ship in 2028. This is a prank, right?”

He later followed up with a video explaining why he believes no one, including himself, will be able to buy the rocket version of the car.

“There’s no way you or I will be able to buy this car. We might as well ignore this becoming a real product. The base one, the fan car one, I can see that being possible. But at this point, I don’t even think it matters, because Tesla has proven to us that the Roadster is by far their least important product,” Brownlee said in his video.

He even questioned if the car would be street legal, adding, “There were several parts of that demo that would not be street legal. The ring extending past the bumper is the easy one. Same with McLaren W1. Maybe this is a GPS restricted track/drag only feature?”

Welp.

Social Media Reacted To Marques Brownlee’s Reaction

Brownlee’s criticism of the Roadster, and his skepticism that it’s real, didn’t sit well with some on social media, who immediately called him a hater and accused him of having EDS (Elon derangement syndrome).

Welp.

You can see more reactions below.

item.content:encoded:
Delonte West is entering a new chapter in his life, announcing that he and his longtime girlfriend, Melissa Anaya, are officially getting married.

It’s been a major turnaround for the former NBA player, who faced difficult time in recent years. Now, West is celebrating a new milestone with the woman who has been by his side for two decades.

Sharing a selfie with Anaya, West announced the news with an excited caption.

“It’s been 20 years, we getting married today!!!”

After 20 years together, the couple is taking the next step in their relationship and making it official.

According to her social media profile, Anaya is teacher from Lawrence, Massachusetts.

Following the marriage announcement, another post featuring the couple appeared online, showing them dressed in wedding attire in what appears to be an AI-generated image. The post celebrated West’s journey and the new chapter he’s beginning with Anaya.

“After everything Delonte has been through, seeing him step into a new chapter of love, peace, and happiness is truly something special. From the NBA courts to the battles behind the scenes, Delonte’s journey has been filled with highs, lows, and moments that tested him — but this chapter is about LOVE and NEW BEGINNINGS.”

item.title: DEI Press Secretary Katie Zacharia Out After Serving Half A Scaramucci, The Jokes Are Immaculate
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Katie Zacharia's struggle run as White House Press Secretary has hilariously ended after only five days.
item.content:encoded:
Katie Zacharia’s struggle run as White House Press Secretary has hilariously ended after only five days.

News of Zacharia breaking Anthony Scaramucci’s record of serving only 10 days as press secretary dropped, followed by Donald Trump sharing what he told Zacharia: “Honestly, if I were you, I’d reconsider. Katie, do you need this? I don’t think you need this,” hinting that he convinced her to step down after only five days on the job, and facing waves of deserved ridicule.

The New York Times shared a story within minutes of Trump’s comments, reporting that she was out, besting Scaramucci’s record, following a disastrous first day behind the podium and a godawful interview on Sean Hannity’s FOX News show where she couldn’t answer softball questions, including one about social media posts where she called herself an attorney, despite not passing the BAR exam.

Her quick dismissal only proves what many believed regarding her hiring: it was purely aesthetic. She had no qualifications that made her fit for the job beyond being an attractive, young, white, blonde woman Trump liked to look at.

How Did Katie Zacharia Get The Job In The First Place?

According to Mother Jones reporting, Zacharia, who is a Trump stan, made sure she put herself in front of cameras so Trump could see he so she could get the job.

Per Mother Jones:

In hopes of replacing Karoline Leavitt, [Zacharia] reportedly cross-referenced the president’s public schedule to book her TV spots, just to make sure that Trump would be watching. Clearly, it worked: On October 9, after weeks of these logistical gymnastics, Trump named Zacharia to the post.

Yeah, Trump keeps surrounding himself with the “best people.”

item.title: SteelSeries Delivers The Perfect Xbox / PC Controller With The Aeon Pro
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: SteelSeries Aeon Pro is a $260 premium controller that eliminates Xbox controller issues with Hall-effect tech, swappable batteries, and an OLED display.
item.content:encoded:
Many consider the standard XBOX controller to be the best option overall for Xbox and PC, but it also has some glaring issues. SteelSeries aims to address some glaring issues with its new controller, the Aeon Pro.

SteelSeries continues to market itself as the brand that supplies all your gaming needs because, at this point, you have to ask: what don’t they make?

With the Aeon Pro, SteelSeries aimed to deliver what is essentially the most advanced and, at $260 the most expensive controller ever made, and it boasts impressive features that justify its asking price. I have been using the controller for the past few weeks, and in my humble opinion, it’s the best thing to happen to XBOX and PC gaming.

“Infinite” Juice & Seamless Swapping

Like many of SteelSeries’ products, mainly the company’s exceptional headsets like the Arctis Nova Elite and Omni Pro, the Aeon Pro takes full advantage of SteelSeries’ beloved infinite battery technology.

Along with steller sound design, software, and hardware, infinite battery helped make SteelSeries a leader in the headset space by removing the worry of plugging in to charge and letting gamers swap out the battery to stay in the game.

With the Aeon Pro utilizing that feature, that continues to be the case because you can swap out the battery for a fresh one that conveniently charges in the dock that can sit on your desk or gaming setup.

The dock also lets you switch seamlessly between Xbox and PC thanks to separate USB-C ports on the back of the dock. You can also connect via Bluetooth through the controller itself, a welcome feature for gamers like me who play across multiple platforms.

You can also switch modes through the Aeon Pro, which lets you know what mode you are on via the built-in OLED Smart Display, which is also a visible feature that I absolutely love and helps the controller stand out from the rest.

Premium Feel & Design

You will immediately notice that the Aeon Pro feels like a $260 controller thanks to Hall-effect thumbsticks paired with a glossy Xbox-layout of ABXY buttons, tactile switch connections, and four programmable paddle buttons located behind the controller.

The Aeon Pro’s left and right triggers also feature two-stage Hall-effect sensors, and all of the buttons, bumpers, paddles, and even the D-pad, as well as the triggers, deliver the most satisfying audible click when put in the short-throw position, which, I might add, helps eliminate the dreaded stick drift.

The wrap-around grip keeps your hand secure during intense single-player or online gaming sessions, keeping you locked in on the moment.

The Eon Pro also features a Modular Stick System offering different thumbstick styles to complement your gaming style.

Final Thoughts

Before picking up Aeon Pro, Razer’s Wolverine V2 Chroma, released back in 2021, was my go-to controller for XBOX and PC gaming.

That is no longer the case; the Aeon Pro has swiftly taken that spot, and for me there is no looking back. For years, I have had a love/hate relationship with the standard XBOX controller due. While it delivers on many fronts, the issues seem to mount up quickly, whether it’s stick drift or the buttons, especially the trigger buttons sticking, totally ruining my experience and forcing me to get another controller.

The Aeon Pro eliminates all of that, and while yes, it is $260 dollars, it will be one of the best investments you will make because you will be using it for years to come.

After using the Aeon Pro for XBOX and PC, it left us hoping and praying SteelSeries is out there cooking up a PS5 controller as well.

You can head to the SteelSeries website right now to purchase the Aeon Pro controller and other SteelSeries products.

*Aeon Pro review unit provided for use by SteelSeries.*

item.title: Megan Thee Stallion Revives Tina Snow Ahead Of New Album And Victoria’s Secret Show
item.dc:creator: Chris Guerrier
item.description: Megan Thee Stallion is bringing back a familiar side of herself as she prepares for a new album and an appearance at the Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show this Sunday. Late last month, the Houston rapper dropped a new freestyle, “Tina Tuesday Freestyle.” This is her first solo release of the year and marks the revival […]
item.content:encoded:
Megan Thee Stallion is bringing back a familiar side of herself as she prepares for a new album and an appearance at the Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show this Sunday.

Late last month, the Houston rapper dropped a new freestyle, “Tina Tuesday Freestyle.” This is her first solo release of the year and marks the revival of Tina Snow, Megan’s alter ego, first introduced on her 2018 EP of the same name. For many fans, the return feels like a reminder of the Megan they first connected with.

The freestyle also reflects Megan’s Houston roots. She raps over a sample of “Still Tippin’” by Mike Jones, a song closely associated with Houston’s Hip-Hop scene. Despite the song’s multiple layers, the music video features Megan in a relatively simple setting. She raps in front of a black backdrop alongside an orange lowrider. The simplicity of the video allows listeners to focus on the music.

Throughout the freestyle, Megan raps about her appearance, success, relationships and the people who continuously watch and criticize her. Tina Snow’s return serves as a reminder to Megan and her fans that returning to your roots and picking up where you started is OK. The return of Tina Snow represents more than just an era; it represents a more confident version of Megan Thee Stallion.

As Megan works on Act III, the follow-up to Megan: Act II, she has been teasing this new but familiar version of herself. Although a release date has yet to be announced, Megan has stated that she is taking her time with the album as she experiments with a new sound and figures out exactly what she wants it to be. She is returning to the roots that helped make her successful.

However, Megan has faced criticism of her flow and rapping style throughout her career. Some critics have even gone so far as to say that all her songs sound the same. With this new album, Megan has an opportunity to prove her critics wrong and demonstrate her versatility as a rapper.

Some critics also continue to associate Megan with controversies she has faced throughout her career. In 2020, Megan was shot in the feet following an argument involving rapper Tory Lanez. Following the incident, some of Lanez’s supporters quickly jumped to his defense, threatening Megan and calling her a liar.

The Canadian rapper was convicted in December 2022 on three felony counts related to the shooting and sentenced to 10 years in prison in August 2023.

Even after the conviction, some of his supporters continued to criticize and harass Megan on social media, blaming her for his conviction. In 2024, Megan released a documentary titled Megan Thee Stallion: In Her Words on Prime Video.

The documentary explores her relationships, the death of her mother, her rise to fame and the shooting, all from Megan’s perspective.

With the release of this new freestyle, the divide between fans and critics is apparent. Many Megan fans have expressed appreciation for the release and excitement about the upcoming album, while others continue to question whether this version of Megan is something new or simply a return to the past.

The return of Tina Snow is exciting because it allows listeners to reflect on and revisit the time when many fans first connected with Megan. If Tina Snow represents Megan’s most confident self, then her return could be exactly what she needs to remain successful.

Chris Guerrier is a junior journalism major at Howard University. He is interested in entertainment and culture reporting. He can be found on Instagram @chrisrguerrier

item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Gucci Mane dropped his new album, Against All Odds, and it’s clear he has a chip on his shoulder. Outside of the 20th-anniversary deluxe edition of Hard To Kill, this marks Wop’s first official release of the year. His last project was 2025’s Episodes, which arrived alongside his book, Episodes: The Diary of a Recovering […]
item.content:encoded:
Gucci Mane dropped his new album, Against All Odds, and it’s clear he has a chip on his shoulder.

Outside of the 20th-anniversary deluxe edition of Hard To Kill, this marks Wop’s first official release of the year. His last project was 2025’s Episodes, which arrived alongside his book, Episodes: The Diary of a Recovering Mad Man.

In both the album and book, the Atlanta legend opened up about his struggles with bipolar disorder and schizophrenia throughout his rise in Hip-Hop. As he continues to navigating this new chapter of his life, Gucci has been reflecting on his past and working to move forward.

Now, with Against All Odds, it feels like the world is getting a taste of the 2006 version of Gucci Mane again. Just look at some of the track title. With records like “Back Against The Wall,” “Y’all Make Me Sick,” and “F*cc Errbody,” Wop isn’t holding back about how he feels.

With a select few features, the Lemonade rapper taps back into the unapologetic energy that fans have come to know and love.

Check out our early takeaways of Gucci Mane’s new album, Against All Odds, below.

item.content:encoded:
GloRilla’s sister, BroRilla, is walking back her past comments about the Memphis rapper.

The past year has been rocky between the sisters. A few months ago, BroRilla spoke with TMZ and aired out her issues with Glo, claiming that her sister wasn’t doing enough to take care of the family.

“She got an obligation to share the wealth. We sat here and struggled together. Yea she obligated, them friends obligated? She doing everything for them. So I feel like I’m obligated. She not doing nothing for the family, at all.”

The FNF rapper later responded with receipts, sharing a FaceTime call with their parents that appeared to contradict BroRilla’s claims.

Fast-forward to now, and it looks like Big Glo’s sister is having a change of heart. BroRilla recently issued a public apology, admitting that her perspective has changed.

“I’m publicly apologizing to my sister. I’m sorry for feeling obligated. And the reason why I’m apologizing is because I’m going through what she could have went through.”

BroRilla went on to explain that she’s now making more money herself, giving her a better understanding of Glo’s position. However, she made it clear that there’s still a major difference between their bank accounts.

“Glo, I apologize because I’m in your shoes now. Well, I’m not in your shoes ‘cause you rich as a motherf*cker, you a millionaire, b*tch. I am a thousand-aire. Let’s not forget that.”

item.title: Duke Dennis & More Continue To Sound Off On ‘Hood Warfare 2’
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Hood Warfare 2, a $5 gang-themed FPS, goes viral on Steam but faces backlash for glorifying Chicago gang violence and perpetuating harmful stereotypes.
item.content:encoded:
Yesterday, Trapstar Games’ Hood Warfare 2 had social media talking, and that continues to be the case as people continue to call out its glorification of Chicago’s gang violence.

For those who don’t know what the hell Hood Warfare 2 is, it’s a $5 Call of Duty clone that features the Bloods and Crips (we wish we were lying) battling out on Chicago’s streets. It is currently enjoying viral success after gameplay clips landed on social media.

The game is currently doing well on Steam and has a “mostly positive” rating based on 1,974 reviews.

Per the game’s Steam page, the description reads:

Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

Hood Warfare 2 brings back the chaotic FPS gameplay and humor of the original, now built in Unreal Engine 5 with updated visuals, new weapon animations, and a new set of maps. Fight through downtown, the suburbs, The Trenches, and Chicago Mall. Hold down the streets or take the fight indoors, with different routes and positions to learn on each map.

Duke Dennis & Others Sound Off on Hood Warfare 2

The game has sparked plenty of chatter on social media, with some believing Hood Warfare 2 is some sort of CIA psyop to keep the Black community down.

The game was also discussed on a recent episode of the Joe Budden Podcast with co-host and gamer Ice, who felt a white person made it and that “it’s some secret hidden marketing” behind it.

AMP member Duke Dennis also shared his thoughts on the game, calling it out for its very stereotypical aspects.

“This game is so fcking cliche & predictable. Whoever made this game just couldn’t be black. If they was black, they either lack social awareness or they just don’t give a fck,” Dennis said during a stream.

RDC World felt the wrath of their chat and social media while streaming Hood Warfare 2.

Another thread is people trying to justify Hood Warfare 2’s existence by comparing it to games like Grand Theft Auto, 50 Cent: Bulletproof, and Saints Row.

But honestly, that is a huge stretch.

It’s going to be interesting as the conversation around Hood Warfare 2 continues, as people continue to push back on its blatant stereotypes and racism.

item.title: Lil Jon Recalls The Day His Son Passed Away In His New Book ‘I Only Shout So You Can Hear Me’
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: Earlier this yer Lil Jon experienced a father’s worst nightmare when his 27-year-old son, Nathan Smith a.k.a. DJ Young Slade, tragically passed away in a drowning accident this past February. Now it seems like Lil Jon is ready to open up about the heartbreaking tragedy as People is reporting that in his new book, I […]
item.content:encoded:
Earlier this yer Lil Jon experienced a father’s worst nightmare when his 27-year-old son, Nathan Smith a.k.a. DJ Young Slade, tragically passed away in a drowning accident this past February.

Now it seems like Lil Jon is ready to open up about the heartbreaking tragedy as People is reporting that in his new book, I Only Shout So You Can Hear Me, Lil Jon writes about the last conversation he had with his son before he disappeared and was ultimately found days later. Telling People that he “needed to share everything I was going through,” Jon says that the book that he had been working on for years is now dedicated to the memory of his first-born son.

In an excerpt from his book, Lil Jon explained how his son was dealing with both mental stress and physical distress which led to Jon sending him to get “all kinds of tests” to see what kind of treatment he could get him in order to help him get better. Unfortunately it seems like it all became too much to bare for the young man as things took a horrible turn in February. Days after Nathan had gone missing, Lil Jon received a call from the police that they might’ve found his son’s body in a lake. Rushing to the scene, Jon had to endure the worst news any parent could ever receive about their child.

Per People:

The officer looked at me with a serious expression painted across his face. “I’m sorry to inform you, but we found your son.”

My head dropped. My heart broke. I was shell-shocked, overwhelmed with pain.

Just as nothing can prepare you for the moment your child enters the world, nothing can prepare you for the moment your child leaves the world.

Sobs filled the air. Then, quickly, I picked my head up and spoke with the officer more. People who were there told me later they felt like I held it together, all things considered. That while I was receiving the worst news of my life, I somehow kept my composure.

It was unthinkable, still. I knew Nathan was in indescribable physical discomfort, that it was debilitating. I knew he was also dealing with emotional pain. A lot of his pain stemmed from fear. That’s why I’d written those text messages after we talked a few days earlier. I hoped he could find relief from the pain and fear that was weighing on him so heavily.

Our hearts go out to Lil Jon and his family.

Though the family was heartbroken that Nathan had passed away, they found comfort in knowing the young man who felt the weight of the world on his shoulders was no longer having to deal with the mental anguish and physical struggles that had plagued him for so long.

The morning of the funeral, though, I woke up with a sense of peace in my heart, in my spirit, and in my soul. I later spoke to Nathan’s mother, and she reiterated the same thing: He is at peace now. His best friend told me he felt the same thing when he woke up that morning. Nathan was no longer in pain.

Lil Jon’s I Only Shout So You Can Hear Me is set to release on October 20th. Will you be checking the book out? Let us know in the comments section below.

item.title: Halle Berry’s Son Allowed To Testify In Custody Battle Amid Abuse Allegations
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Halle Berry and Olivier Martinez’s custody battle is getting messier, and now their teenage son could be called to testify in court. A judge has ruled that the former couple’s 13-year-old son, Maceo, can testify in the ongoing legal dispute following Martinez’s shocking allegations that Berry abused their child. “The minor child is permitted to […]
item.content:encoded:
Halle Berry and Olivier Martinez’s custody battle is getting messier, and now their teenage son could be called to testify in court.

A judge has ruled that the former couple’s 13-year-old son, Maceo, can testify in the ongoing legal dispute following Martinez’s shocking allegations that Berry abused their child.

“The minor child is permitted to testify,” Los Angeles Superior Court Judge Shelley Kaufman said in court documents obtained by the Daily Mail. However, the judge limited the testimony to “the request for the issuance of a restraining order.”

The ruling comes days after Martinez, 60, asked the court to allow Maceo to “address the court” and share his account of the alleged incident involving Berry, also 60, according to Page Six.

“Given that our son is 13 years old, I believe it would certainly be in his best interest for him to address the court at this time,” the French actor said in court documents.

“He should have the opportunity to have his voice heard regarding what he experienced that night,” Martinez added, arguing that their son’s testimony would be key to helping the court establish what happened on Sept. 26.

“I am the parent who wants the truth to come out. I am the parent who does not want to suppress Maceo’s voice,” he said.

Martinez has also asked the judge to block Berry’s daughter, Nahla Aubry, from testifying after the teenager reportedly defended her famous mother against the allegations.

“Ms. Aubry does not have any significant bearing on this case,” Martinez claimed in his filing, adding that she was “unquestionably biased.” He also argued that Berry should not involve her daughter in litigation that does not concern her.

Last month, Martinez filed for a temporary restraining order against Berry, accusing the Monster’s Ball actress of jumping on Maceo, putting her hands around his neck and choking him. Berry has vehemently denied the allegations.

The dispute has already affected the former couple’s custody arrangement. Martinez was granted primary custody of Maceo, while Berry was ordered to see their son two days a week and every other weekend.

Berry and Martinez married in 2013 and finalized their divorce in 2016. Now, nearly a decade after their marriage ended, their private family dispute is playing out in court, with their teenage son potentially caught in the middle.

item.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto 6’s Launch Trailer Features Crime, Shower Sex & A New Song Featuring SZA
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Surprise, we got another look at Grand Theft Auto 6 ahead of its locked-in November 19 release date. Unlike the other trailers, there were no teases or indications this was coming, but here we are.
item.content:encoded:
While Cyberleek is still out here trying to spoil Grand Theft Auto 6 after his crypto scheme flopped, Rockstar Games dropped the launch trailer for the highly anticipated game, and it’s packed with new details.

Surprise, we got another look at Grand Theft Auto 6 ahead of its locked-in November 19 release date. Unlike the other trailers, there were no teases or indications this was coming, but here we are.

We Learn Jason’s Motives In Grand Theft Auto 6’s Launch Trailer

In the new trailer, which will likely air on television and before movies in theaters, further signaling that the game’s promotional machine is fully revved up, we quickly learn why Jason, one of the game’s protagonists, chose a life of crime.

 “I got in trouble in the army. Didn’t leave on the best of terms. They don’t give loans or anything to people like me,” Jason says in the 1:30 trailer.

The trailer also teases plenty of gunplay, car driving, crimes being committed, and, shockingly, steamy shower sex between Jason and his partner Lucia, further cementing that they are a couple and possibly teasing that this game will feature intimate moments that could put GTA V’s “hot coffee” mod to shame.

It was also hilarious to see Lucia still wearing her ankle monitor while Jason showers with her.

Like other GTA game trailers, this one also features music, a new song from the electronic duo Justice, who also scored Grand Theft Auto 6. The new track is called “Flower in a Hurricane,” and it features Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard, and it will live on the companion album that will be dropped alongside the game.

The launch trailer follows a GamesBeat report claiming GTA 6 is coming to PC in the first quarter of 2027.

As you can imagine, the latest trailer only adds to the massive hype around this game. You can see those reactions below.

item.title: Ava DuVernay Drops A Film Industry Hot Take: “Hollywood Is Over”
item.dc:creator: Keenan Higgins
item.description: Famed director Ava DuVernay made a bold comment about the state of the film industry amid current mergers and studio collapses in Hollywood.
item.content:encoded:
The film industry is going through a major shift at the moment as insiders and moviegoers alike try to make sense of the viral Paramount-Warner Bros. merger officially known as Skydance.

Famed director Ava DuVernay appeared on stage this past Monday (October 12) during the 70th BFI London Film Festival for a panel discussion centered on her latest documentary, 14th. In addition to giving some insight on her career path to date, she also made a bold statement regarding the current state of Hollywood.

Let’s just say DuVernay has a grave answer to what the mega-merger will mean for filmmaking.

RELATED: Little Known Black History Fact: Ava DuVernay’s 13th

The Billionaires Are Building Their Own Skynet. We’re Cooked

According to The Hollywood Reporter, DuVernay put an emphasis on crowdfunding during the Q&A session when asked how producers could finance films like hers, stating, “You put your movie up there, and there are all kinds of apps and sites that allow people who are like-minded to do it.” She went on to add, “But [it’s about] also just asking people, getting 20 people investing $5,000 — a nice amount of money to say something or make something. And there are ways to get that money back, whether it’s through taking the film around to different film festivals or YouTubing it or selling it. This is what we’re going back to.”

In highlighting how important alternate funding will be, the Emmy-winning filmmaker made her point clear by simply stating her hot take: “Hollywood is over.”

Doubling down on her point, she went on to tell the audience, “Did you guys hear?  It’s done. They’re buying each other, they’re collapsing. It’s all changed.  They’re selling studio lots. The idea of going to Sundance and getting a three-picture deal from Harvey Weinstein? He’s in prison.”

She summarized her point by noting that creatives will now more than ever have to rely on making direct connections to their audiences without the film studios acting as a middle man.

Although Netflix serves as the middle man when it comes to 14th, for DuVernay it’s about spreading the message as far as possible. The documentary gives historic context behind the 14 Amendment, and the current systematic attack against it regarding citizenship rights and equal protection under the law. In the same conversation, she spoke on the experience of making it by stating, “This film saved me in a lot of ways. … The rage that I feel and the fear that I feel, I was really being able to pour it into 14th every day. I only finished the film two weeks ago, and so I really don’t know what I’m going to do from here.”

We don’t think anyone wants to see Hollywood come to a full stop, but her point was made in making note of the power in shifting towards a DIY approach. With the rise of Skydance and a new generation questioning their place in the game, these are the conversations that will shape the future of filmmaking.

item.title: Social Media Believes $5 ‘Call of Duty’ Clone, ‘Hood Warfare 2’ Was Planted By The CIA
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Hood Warfare 2, a $5 gang-based FPS game, went viral on social media but sparked controversy over its problematic subject matter and allegations of CIA involvement.
item.content:encoded:
A $5 Call of Duty-style FPS game where the Bloods and Crips fight over territory in Chicago? If you’re wondering whether this is a real game, yes, it is, and it’s currently gone viral on social media.

The game, which costs only the price of four chicken wings from the hood Chinese restaurant, is currently on Steam with very positive reviews and follows the original game, which peaked at 68 players when it first dropped.

Now, thanks to social media, Hood Warfare 2 from developer Trapstar Games is enjoying the success the first title missed out on.

The official synopsis for the game reads:

‘Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

Hood Warfare 2 brings back the chaotic FPS gameplay and humor of the original, now built in Unreal Engine 5 with updated visuals, new weapon animations, and a new set of maps. Fight through downtown, the suburbs, The Trenches, and Chicago Mall. Hold down the streets or take the fight indoors, with different routes and positions to learn on each map.

Weapon customization gets an upgrade, too. Change out sights, magazines, grips, suppressors, and other attachments to get your gun how you want it. Set up your loadout with perks and equipment before heading into a match.’

Like the first game, the player count started out slow, but quickly ballooned as people like the folks from RDC World streamed it.

Social Media Believes Hood Warfare 2 Was Planted By The CIA

But it shouldn’t come as a surprise that a game based on such a problematic subject is sparking outrage, with a lot of critics calling out the fact that the game features Black gang members trying to kill each other in a game allegedly created by a white developer using AI.

Other complaints claim the game was somehow planted by the CIA and is nothing but a tool to keep Black folks down.

We’re not gonna hold you to it, but this game looks like a hot mess and isn’t worth $5. But it appears that’s not stopping people from playing it.

item.title: Urban One Enters Microseries Market With Thrillers ‘Power & Influence’ and ‘Foul Play’
item.dc:creator: Keenan Higgins
item.description: Urban One launches two original vertical microseries on TikTok optimized for mobile viewing, expanding entertainment into the growing digital streaming market.
item.content:encoded:
The world of entertainment is growing to match the times, particularly with digital streaming changing how we watch and enjoy our favorite shows. With the convenience of viewing straight from a phone screen paired with the new trend of clip sharing on social media, a new market in the industry developed with the rise of the microseries.

Urban One was clever enough to get in on the action with the announcement of two original vertical microseries created for mobile viewing to air on BOSSIP’s TikTok.

RELATED: True Crime Podcast Infamy, Joins Urban One’s Podcast Network

Both Power & Influence (seen above) and Foul Play will each include 20 episodes that average 90 seconds and expected to extend across Urban One’s multiplatform media ecosystem following its TikTok premiere. Power & Influence kicks things off beginning October 19 with a corporate thriller plot driven by AI deepfakes exposing hidden scandals at one of Atlanta’s most respected Black-owned advertising agencies. The cast includes Ivory Shields (Queen Sugar), Tanazia Madan (Nappily Ever After), Jay Jones (Lovecraft Country), De’Tuan Williams (Fear Lake Lanier), Ashley Brittney Silva (Love & Marriage: DC), Donny Carrington (Beyond the Gates). The series comes from the combined creativity of writer by Dreux Dougall of Lovecraft Country fame, director Jamal Simmons from Married at First Sight) and executive producer Ma’at Zachary.

Women’s basketball revenge thriller Foul Play is currently in production, bringing to life the directorial debut of former professional women’s basketball player and assistant coach, Ty Young. The series centers on a highly skilled military veteran and sports mom who seeks retribution against the corrupt coach, referee and player who conspired to injure her star point-guard daughter during a high-stakes tournament. Tanya Hoffler-Moore (Tyler Perry’s House of Payne) will write and executive produce, with co-direction and and co-production from Leon Lozano (All American: Homecoming) and women’s basketball players Ashley MacCalla and Sydney MacCalla.

“These microseries give brands an opportunity to connect authentically with our audiences through stories rooted in their culture and interests,” said Jeff Meza, Urban One’s EVP, Head of Branded Entertainment & Integrated Marketing. He also adds, “Partners can become part of those stories from the outset, with opportunities that extend across Urban One platforms.” That plan will include editorial support across iONE Digital properties like Hip-Hop Wired and MadameNoire, versions adapted for TV One, connected TV and free ad-supported streaming channels, plus promotion across Radio One stations, REACH Media syndicated shows and the Urban One Podcast Network.

Get the popcorn ready, and make sure to charge up your mobile devices!

item.title: The Top 25 Most Pest-Infested Cities in America
item.dc:creator: Nick Cottongim
item.description: Los Angeles tops the list of America's most pest-infested cities, followed by Chicago and Washington D.C. Regional patterns show Midwest and Northeast cities struggle with bed bugs and rodents, while Southern cities battle termites and mosquitoes.
item.content:encoded:
The Top 25 Most Pest-Infested Cities in America

Nobody wants to share their home with uninvited guests, but in some American cities, the bugs and critters have practically signed the lease. A new ranking from PestControlPricing.com combines Orkin’s 2025 top-50 lists for bed bugs, rodents, mosquitoes and termites into a single score.

A perfect 200 would mean a city topped all four lists. Los Angeles comes in at No. 1 with a near-perfect 196, leading the nation in both rodents and mosquitoes. Chicago follows close behind as the bed bug capital of the country, and Washington, D.C. rounds out the top three.

And yes, Indianapolis made the cut, landing at No. 10 overall, mostly because it ranks No. 5 for bed bugs.

Cities in the Midwest and Northeast tend to struggle most with bed bugs and rats, while Southern cities fight termites and mosquitoes.

Here’s the full list of the 25 most pest-infested cities in America, ranked by composite score.

RELATED | Craziest Haunted House Attractions In America

RELATED | 2026 Best Small Cities in America

1. Los Angeles, CA (196/200)

America’s top city for both rats and mosquitoes, and the mosquito capital four years running. It also ranks #2 for termites and #4 for bed bugs. Warm weather, a dense population and standing water keep pests active all year.

media:content.media:title: Bed Bug Crawling On Fabric Surface
